heading: Simple, secure video meetings
intro: Talk face to face with your team and your clients. Guests join from a link, with no account needed.
joinInputError: Use a meeting link or code. Examples:
joinMeetingTipContent: You can join a meeting by pasting its full link in the browser's address bar.

createMenu.laterOption: Create a meeting for a later date

laterMeetingDialog.heading: Your connection details
laterMeetingDialog.description: Share this information with the guests. They will be able to join the meeting without needing to sign in. This meeting is permanent and can be reused.
laterMeetingDialog.permissions: People with this link do not need your permission to join this meeting.

slide1.title: Start a meeting in two clicks
slide1.body: Create a room and share the link. Anyone you send it to joins straight from the browser, with nothing to install.

slide2.title: Group calls without a time limit
slide2.body: Meetings run for as long as you need them to, with no cap on call length and no per-seat licence to count.

slide3.title: Runs on Dumont infrastructure
slide3.body: Calls are carried by Dumont’s own media server, so meeting audio and video never pass through a third-party provider.
